sloka: तद्गच्छ कुरु साहाय्यं स्वबलेनाभिसंवृतः।क्षिप्रमृक्षपते तस्य कपिश्रेष्ठस्य युध्यतः ।। ६.८३.३ ।।
transliteration: tadgaccha kuru sāhāyyaṁ svabalenābhisaṁvṛtaḥ।kṣipramṛkṣapate tasya kapiśreṣṭhasya yudhyataḥ ।। 6.83.3 ।।

translations.english: "O King of Bears! Accompanied by your army, go to the battlefield and help the best of monkeys."
